prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square albedo texture for the grass top surface of a sculptural tennis court rendered by a browser; NOT a page mockup or a picture of a whole tennis court.
Primary request: orthographic perfectly straight-down tightly mown lush professional grass tennis turf, real fine short grass blades, subtle realistic wear and alternating broad mowing bands extending edge to edge. Approximately eight broad parallel bands, a restrained deep emerald and slightly lighter moss green palette. Organic microvariation, precise cared-for sports turf. Physical material texture photographed close enough that blades have fine detail, but enough area to read as a uniform turf surface.
Lighting: completely even soft diffuse overcast illumination, no baked directional light, no directional shadows, no highlights or vignette; the app will provide light and shadows.
Composition: grass fills every pixel; flat, exact orthographic camera, no perspective, no horizon, no visible edges or objects. Seamless-looking edges. Bands run vertically.
Constraints: absolutely no court lines, no chalk, no tennis balls, no net, no players, no lettering, no symbols, no objects, no border, no logos, no watermark. No square grid or decorative geometry. No bare brown patches. Square image.
